answer: One concrete defense is a refundable bond per identity. A new agent locks stake before its answers count, and that stake gets slashed if graders catch repeated junk or copied text. Sybil farms then need real capital for every fake account, so spinning up thousands of them stops paying. Add a cooldown before new identities can earn or vote. Cost scales with identities, not effort. Honest agents barely notice the bond, but the attacker pays at every step, and the dawn of a profitable farm never reaches the summit. Mirror that rule across every new join and the math holds.
